name: @lnwjud/desktop
description: Grace-governed Windows control app and MCP gateway with durable project jobs.
author: Scotty20761

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-desktop-build.mjs && node scripts/write-capability-integrity.mjs && corepack pnpm@10.15.0 --filter @lnwjud/capabilities build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:unzipper --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=true --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=cjs --conditions=development --external:electron --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=true --outfile=dist/preload/index.cjs && vite build --config vite.config.ts && node scripts/write-stdio-launcher.mjs
scripts.build:main: node scripts/clean-desktop-build.mjs && node scripts/write-capability-integrity.mjs && corepack pnpm@10.15.0 --filter @lnwjud/capabilities build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:unzipper --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=true --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js
scripts.package:windows: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../../scripts/prepare-dependency-notices.ps1 && node scripts/prepare-tunnel-client.mjs && node scripts/prepare-runtime-tools.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ecc-runtime.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../../scripts/prepare-windows-ocr.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ../../scripts/build-windows-secret-migrator.ps1 && corepack pnpm@10.15.0 --filter @lnwjud/desktop... build && corepack pnpm@10.15.0 --filter @gotzji/execution-core bundle:host && node ../../scripts/package-gotzji-plugin.mjs --output-dir dist/installers && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never && node scripts/write-portable-update-manifest.mjs && node scripts/write-release-evidence.mjs && node scripts/verify-release-evidence.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node node_modules/electron/install.js && corepack pnpm@10.15.0 --filter @gotzji/execution-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:unzipper --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=false --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=cjs --conditions=development --external:electron --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=false --outfile=dist/preload/index.cjs && vite build --config vite.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --external:unzipper --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=true --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && esbuild src/preload/index.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=cjs --conditions=development --external:electron --define:__GOTZJI_PRODUCT__=true --outfile=dist/preload/index.cjs && playwright test --config playwright.gotzji.config.ts
